"""Read selected original layer15 weights without loading a model or using a GPU."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,socket,struct,time
assert socket.gethostname()=='aitopatom-66c4'
root=Path('<private-home>/prefix-row906-upstream15-weights-r1');root.mkdir()
model=Path('/mnt/data/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B')
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for part in iter(lambda:f.read(8<<20),b''):h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()
start=time.monotonic();index=model/'model.safetensors.index.json'
assert sha(index)=='41b9356101ebf8e7519e150dc811f80c4226e727301fbb032b890f006ed0be83'
assert sha(model/'config.json')=='93a4693fa9d8392fbfccd4b3c9873f4bfdcb14fdede978b123d07d19675efe99'
mapping=json.loads(index.read_text())['weight_map']
experts=[42,45,58,78,85,86,93,94,123,126,132,137,157,184,190,204,220,228,245]
prefix='model.language_model.layers.15.'
targets=[(prefix+'mlp.experts.down_proj',[256,2048,512],i) for i in experts]
targets += [(prefix+k,shape,None) for k,shape in {
    'mlp.shared_expert.down_proj.weight':[2048,512],
    'self_attn.o_proj.weight':[2048,4096],
    'input_layernorm.weight':[2048],
    'post_attention_layernorm.weight':[2048]}.items()]
files=[];shards={}
for key,shape,expert in targets:
    shard=mapping[key];path=model/shard
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        hs=struct.unpack('<Q',f.read(8))[0];assert 0<hs<=16<<20
        entry=json.loads(f.read(hs))[key]
        assert entry['dtype']=='BF16' and entry['shape']==shape
        first,last=entry['data_offsets'];n=1
        for axis in shape:n*=axis
        assert last-first==n*2 and 8+hs+last<=path.stat().st_size
        offset=8+hs+first
        selected_shape=shape
        if expert is not None:
            assert 0<=expert<shape[0];n//=shape[0];offset+=expert*n*2;selected_shape=shape[1:]
        f.seek(offset);raw=f.read(n*2)
    assert len(raw)==n*2
    file=key.replace('.','-')+('' if expert is None else '-expert'+str(expert))+'-bf16.bin'
    dest=root/file
    with dest.open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
    files.append(dict(key=key,expert=expert,tensor_shape=shape,shape=selected_shape,dtype='bf16',shard=shard,
        offset=offset,file=file,bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(dest)))
    if shard not in shards:shards[shard]=dict(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path))
    assert time.monotonic()-start<60
record=dict(kind='readonly_original_reference_model_selected_upstream_weights',host=socket.gethostname(),model=str(model),
    model_index_sha256=sha(index),model_config_sha256=sha(model/'config.json'),
    command_file=__file__,command_file_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),files=files,shards=shards,
    selected_experts=experts,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
    model_loaded=False,gpu_execution=False,diagnostic_only=True,inference_acceptance=False)
with (root/'weights-source.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(record))

compare_gb10_row906_moe15_dots_r1.py.text:
"""Qualify selected routed-down arithmetic on original independent reference rows."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,struct,subprocess
from analyze_prefix96_linear_capture_r1 import compare
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P=Path('<private-home>/projects/AIMA-public-r1191-candidate')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
D=B/'prefix-row906-upstream15-weights-r1';weights=read(D/'verified-source.json')
assert weights['all_downloaded_files_verified'] and not weights['gpu_execution']
for f in weights['files']:assert sha(D/f['file'])==f['sha256']
R=B/'qrt-gb10-prefix128-row906-upstream15-20260919-r1';authority=read(R/'boundary-analysis.json')
assert authority['reference_qualified'] and authority['original512_output_ids_and_full_first_logits_reproduced']
prior=read(B/'prefix128-layer16-projection-weights-r1/original-row906-dots-r1/comparison.json')
exe=B/'prefix-linear-dot-row906-r1';assert sha(exe)==prior['executable_sha256']
assert sha(B/'prefix_linear_dot_r1.cpp')==prior['observer_source_sha256']
out=D/'original-routed-down-dots-r1';out.mkdir()
def put(p,data):
    with p.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
def f32(x):return struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
def bf16(x):
    u=struct.unpack('<I',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
    return ((u+0x7fff+((u>>16)&1))>>16)&65535
results=[]
for position in (91017,91018,91019,91020,91021):
    target=next(r for r in authority['selected_moe_rows'] if r['position']==position)
    def selected(label,width):
        f=target['files'][label];p=B/f['local_file'];assert sha(p)==f['sha256']
        size=2 if f['dtype']=='bf16' else 4
        assert f['selected_bytes']==width*size
        start=f['row_index']*width*size;data=p.read_bytes()[start:start+width*size]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==f['selected_sha256']
        return data
    ids=struct.unpack('<8i',selected('topk-ids',8));route_weights=struct.unpack('<8f',selected('topk-weights',8))
    assert set(ids)<=set(weights['selected_experts'])
    act=selected('routed-activated',4096);expected=selected('routed-weighted',16384)
    for route,expert in enumerate(ids):
        inp=out/(str(position)+'-route'+str(route)+'-activated-bf16.bin')
        ref=out/(str(position)+'-route'+str(route)+'-reference-weighted-bf16.bin')
        put(inp,act[route*1024:(route+1)*1024]);put(ref,expected[route*4096:(route+1)*4096])
        wf=next(f for f in weights['files'] if f['expert']==expert);weight=D/wf['file']
        actual=out/(str(position)+'-route'+str(route)+'-canonical-f32.bin')
        cmd=[str(exe),str(weight),str(inp),'2048','512',str(actual)]
        run=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);run.check_returncode()
        vals=struct.unpack('<2048f',actual.read_bytes());assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in vals)
        weighted=out/(str(position)+'-route'+str(route)+'-weighted-bf16.bin')
        put(weighted,struct.pack('<2048H',*[bf16(f32(v*route_weights[route])) for v in vals]))
        compared=compare(weighted,'bf16',ref,'bf16',1,2048)
        results.append(dict(position=position,route=route,expert=expert,route_weight=route_weights[route],
            command=cmd,weight_sha256=sha(weight),input_sha256=sha(inp),projection_sha256=sha(actual),comparison=compared))
proof=dict(kind='original_gb10_layer15_selected_routed_down_cpu_dots',reference_analysis_sha256=sha(R/'boundary-analysis.json'),
    model=weights['model'],weights_source_sha256=sha(D/'verified-source.json'),source_commit=authority['source_commit'],
    observer=Path(__file__).name,observer_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),executable_sha256=sha(exe),
    accumulator_header_sha256=sha(P/'native/providers/moe_accumulator/q1_moe_hawkeye_bf16_accumulator.h'),
    recipe='Ascending canonical K16 FP32 dot followed by FP32 multiplication with original route weight and one RNE BF16 store.',
    results=results,diagnostic_only=True,model_inference=False,gpu_execution=False,inference_acceptance=False)
with (out/'comparison.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(results),elements=81920,total_bf16_mismatches=sum(r['comparison']['summary']['bf16_mismatches'] for r in results),
    differing_cases=[{k:r[k] for k in ('position','route','expert')}|r['comparison']['summary'] for r in results if r['comparison']['summary']['bf16_mismatches']]),indent=2))

compare_gb10_full15_output_cpu_r1.py.text:
"""Qualify exact CPU output and consumer arithmetic on original full-attention rows."""
from pathlib import Path
from array import array
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from analyze_prefix96_linear_capture_r1 import compare
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
reference=B/'qrt-gb10-prefix128-row906-upstream15-20260919-r1';authority=read(reference/'boundary-analysis.json')
assert authority['reference_qualified'] and authority['original512_output_ids_and_full_first_logits_reproduced']
cases=read(reference/'capture/capture.json')['cases']
weights_dir=B/'prefix-row906-upstream15-weights-r1';weights=read(weights_dir/'verified-source.json')
assert weights['all_downloaded_files_verified'] and not weights['gpu_execution']
dot_proof=read(B/'prefix128-layer16-projection-weights-r1/original-row906-dots-r1/comparison.json')
norm_proof=read(B/'prefix128-layer16-projection-weights-r1/original-row906-norms-r1/comparison.json')
dot=B/'prefix-linear-dot-row906-r1';norm=B/'prefix-linear-norm-row906-r1'
assert sha(dot)==dot_proof['executable_sha256'] and sha(norm)==norm_proof['executable_sha256']
assert all(r['comparison']['summary']['bf16_mismatches']==0 for r in dot_proof['results']+norm_proof['results'])
table=B/'qrt-rsqrt-table-20260910-r1/table/sm121-rsqrt-positive.bin'
assert sha(table)==norm_proof['table_sha256']
def weight(suffix):
    row=next(r for r in weights['files'] if r['key']=='model.language_model.layers.15.'+suffix)
    p=weights_dir/row['file'];assert sha(p)==row['sha256'];return p
out=weights_dir/'original-full15-output-cpu-r1';out.mkdir();results=[]
plans=[('q7169-out32',7168),('q8192-out32',8191)]+[('long-prefix131072-owner-out512',p) for p in (906,90111,91017,91018,91019,91020,91021,98303)]
for name,position in plans:
    case=next(c for c in cases if c['name']==name);w=case['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
    selected=[(t,i,q) for t in w['transactions'] for i,q in enumerate(t['qualified_rows']) if q['position']==position and q['matches_generated_history']]
    assert len(selected)==1;t,ri,q=selected[0]
    def select(label,width,float_output=False):
        f=next(f for f in w['files'].values() if f['transaction']==t['ordinal'] and f['label']==label)
        original=reference/'capture'/name/f['file'];data=original.read_bytes();assert sha(original)==f['sha256'] and len(data)==f['bytes']
        assert f['dtype'] in ('f32','bf16');size=2 if f['dtype']=='bf16' else 4
        assert len(data)==len(t['qualified_rows'])*width*size
        raw=data[ri*width*size:(ri+1)*width*size];kind=f['dtype']
        if float_output and kind=='bf16':
            v=array('H');v.frombytes(raw);raw=array('I',(int(x)<<16 for x in v)).tobytes();kind='f32'
        path=out/(name+'-'+str(position)+'-'+label+'-'+kind+'.bin')
        if not path.exists():
            with path.open('xb') as h:h.write(raw)
        else:assert path.read_bytes()==raw
        return path,kind
    gated,kind=select('full-15-gated',4096);assert kind=='bf16'
    expected,kind=select('full-15-output',2048)
    generated=out/(name+'-'+str(position)+'-out-canonical-f32.bin')
    commands=[[str(dot),str(weight('self_attn.o_proj.weight')),str(gated),'2048','4096',str(generated)]]
    run=subprocess.run(commands[-1],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45);run.check_returncode()
    projection=compare(generated,'f32',expected,kind,1,2048)
    seed,_=select('layer-14-combined',2048,True);update,_=select('full-15-output',2048,True)
    expected_norm,norm_kind=select('layer-15-post-attention-rmsnorm',2048)
    prefix=out/(name+'-'+str(position)+'-consumer')
    commands.append([str(norm),'consumer',str(seed),str(update),str(weight('post_attention_layernorm.weight')),str(table),'-',str(prefix)])
    run=subprocess.run(commands[-1],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15);run.check_returncode()
    consumer=compare(Path(str(prefix)+'-norm-bf16.bin'),'bf16',expected_norm,norm_kind,1,2048)
    results.append(dict(case=name,position=position,transaction=t['ordinal'],qualified_row=q,commands=commands,projection=projection,consumer=consumer))
proof=dict(kind='qualified_original_gb10_full15_output_and_consumer_cpu_comparison',reference_analysis_sha256=sha(reference/'boundary-analysis.json'),
    weights_source_sha256=sha(weights_dir/'verified-source.json'),dot_executable_sha256=sha(dot),norm_executable_sha256=sha(norm),
    observer_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),results=results,diagnostic_only=True,inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False)
with (out/'comparison.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps([dict(case=r['case'],position=r['position'],projection_bf16_mismatches=r['projection']['summary']['bf16_mismatches'],consumer_bf16_mismatches=r['consumer']['summary']['bf16_mismatches']) for r in results],indent=2))
